summary: Platform-specific prebuilt binary package with no observed harmful behavior
details: Package @k18k/entrypoint-sdk-darwin-x64@0.2.0 is a platform-specific (darwin-x64) distribution of a prebuilt SDK, typical of the npm optionalDependencies pattern used to deliver per-platform native binaries. No install-time lifecycle scripts, exfiltration code, credential reads, network callbacks, or dropper behavior were observed in the shipped files. The tarball primarily contains a platform-specific binary artifact selected by the parent SDK at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
